# PR #3355: Patch: one Tabs and one segmented-toggle component for the menus' tabs and filters

Closes #3222

### Summary of Changes

This patch resolves issue #3222 by unifying tab and segmented filter controls into two reusable components sharing a single design-token stylesheet, standardizing `<select>` filter touch targets, and migrating views across the web application.

1. **`Tabs` Component (`apps/web/src/tabs/Tabs.tsx`)**:
   - Implements the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with `role="tablist"`, `role="tab"`, and `role="tabpanel"`.
   - Full keyboard navigation with roving `tabIndex` (0 on active tab, -1 on inactive tabs) and `ArrowRight`, `ArrowLeft`, `Home`, and `End` keys with boundary wrapping.
   - Associated attributes: `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`, and `aria-labelledby`.
   - Supports both dynamic unmounting and `keepMounted` (hidden panel retention).
   - Exports types `TabItem` and `TabsProps` via `apps/web/src/tabs/index.ts`.

2. **`Segmented` Component (`apps/web/src/tabs/Segmented.tsx`)**:
   - One-of-n toggle button group with `role="group"` and `role="button"` on segments.
   - Selected state reflected via `aria-pressed="true"` and `.segmented__item--selected` (deriving styling from button tokens rather than `button-primary`).
   - Keyboard arrow navigation (`ArrowRight`, `ArrowLeft`) with focus management and disabled state skipping.
   - Exports types `SegmentOption` and `SegmentedProps` via `apps/web/src/tabs/index.ts`.

3. **Unified Stylesheet (`apps/web/src/tabs/tabs.css`)**:
   - Zero raw hex/rgb colors, zero raw pixel spacing, and zero unroled button class skins.
   - Enforces `min-height: var(--hit-min)` (44px) across tabs and segmented items per R2122000.
   - Provides shared `.select-filter`, `.stats-select`, and `.dungeon-stats__select` styles ensuring `<select>` dropdown filters satisfy `min-height: var(--hit-min)` (R2122000).

4. **Component Migrations**:
   - [SettingsPanel.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx): Migrated manual tablist and panel logic to `<Tabs>`, retaining existing testids (`settings-tablist`, `settings-tab-${id}`, `settings-section-${id}`) and container refs (`settings-body`).
   - [stats.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx): Migrated view tabs (Cards, Sets, Players) to `<Tabs>`, adding arrow key navigation and roving tabindex; migrated Table / Grid view switcher to `<Segmented>`.
   - [stats.css](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/routes/stats.css): Removed redundant custom `.stats-tab` and `.stats-view-btn` styles.
   - [leaderboard.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/routes/leaderboard.tsx): Migrated ladder selector to `<Segmented>`, removing `button-primary` from the active segment.
   - [LooksScreen.tsx](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/collection/LooksScreen.tsx): Migrated payment method options to `<Segmented>`.

5. **Design Token Ratchet Suites**:
   - Updated frozen counts in [buttons.test.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/buttons.test.ts) (8 → 5), [palette.test.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/palette.test.ts) (82 → 76), [spacing.test.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/spacing.test.ts) (82 → 78), and [typescale.test.ts](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3222/apps/web/src/typescale.test.ts) (29 → 28) following the removal of redundant custom button and tab styles in `routes/stats.css`.

---

### Controls Retained As-Is

Per the acceptance criteria, the following controls remain without migration:
- **Deck Builder Filter Chips (`FilterBar.tsx`, `.db-chip`)**: True multi-select filters where players can select multiple costs, rarities, card types, sets, and tags simultaneously.
- **Dungeon Run Selection (`StartScreen.tsx`)**: Multi-select pools with card/relic previews, point cap rules, and custom seed controls (re-clicking random generates a new seed with an associated text input).
- **Sandbox Search Results (`SandboxPanel.tsx`)**: Dynamic query search results rendered as mini card faces (`ResultCard`), not a fixed one-of-n option set.
- **Radio Inputs in `play.tsx` and `SeriesPicker.tsx`**: Rich multi-line cards containing queue times, status indicators, and `<fieldset>` semantic forms.
- **`<select>` Filters in `stats.tsx` and `DungeonStats.tsx`**: Long option dropdowns (e.g., card sets, rarities, patches); retained as `<select>` with shared `min-height: var(--hit-min)` styling (R2122000).

---

### Verification & Tests

- **Unit Tests**:
  - `apps/web/src/tabs/Tabs.test.tsx` (8/8 passed): Verified WAI-ARIA roles, attributes, roving `tabIndex`, arrow navigation, `Home`/`End` keys, `keepMounted`, and `onChange` callback.
  - `apps/web/src/tabs/Segmented.test.tsx` (7/7 passed): Verified `role="group"`, `aria-pressed`, absence of `button-primary`, arrow navigation, disabled option handling, and `onChange` callback.
  - `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx` (69/69 passed): Added arrow key navigation test for statistics tabs; all existing tests pass.
  - `apps/web/src/settings/tabs.test.tsx` (14/14 passed) and `apps/web/src/settings/wiring.test.tsx` (21/21 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/routes/leaderboard.test.tsx` (12/12 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/collection/LooksScreen.test.tsx` (12/12 passed).
- **Token & Consistency Suites**:
  - `apps/web/src/buttons.test.ts` (5/5 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/palette.test.ts` (6/6 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/spacing.test.ts` (5/5 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/typescale.test.ts` (6/6 passed).
  - `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts` (6/6 passed).
- **Linting, Typechecks & Tooling**:
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: 0 errors.
  - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`: 0 errors.
  - `cargo fmt --check`: 0 diffs.
  - `cargo jackioh catalog check`: Validated 774 entries, OK.
  - `cargo jackioh patches check`: OK.
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`: 1788 rulings, 4475 proofs, 54961 citations: OK.
